episode.title: This PLASTIC Bottle Turns To STONE!

synopsis: A man discovers a plastic water bottle that instantly transforms into a rigid, stone-like material when touched, then reverts to flexible plastic when released.
narration: This water bottle has been doing this weird thing all morning. When I touch it, it just turns hard, like stone, then softens right back. It's truly baffling...

shots.prompt: A translucent blue plastic water bottle, standard commercial size, with a perfectly smooth, unblemished surface that feels hard and brittle like stone, possessing a deep, resonant quality when tapped. The plastic's molecular structure rapidly reconfigures, transforming it into a dense, grey, stone-like material upon manipulation, which then reverts to flexible plastic when released. The composition is a fixed, eye-level view of hands interacting with the water bottle on the dark wood living room table. A familiar living-room coffee table: dark wood top with two pale water rings, a folded magazine at the frame edge, the soft blur of a sofa behind, and warm lamp light mixed with grey window daylight. A pair of hands wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt firmly grips a translucent blue plastic water bottle resting on the dark wood living room table; the area under the grip is already solid, grey, and stone-like, visibly contrasting with the plastic top.
shots.violation_observation: The portion of the bottle under the hand's grip is visibly transformed into a solid, grey, stone-like material.
